topic: Walking into a First Yoga Class

script.title: MY FIRST YOGA CLASS
script.scene_zh: 瑜伽教室 · 第一次上課
script.story_hook: A nervous newcomer meets her very first yoga mat.
script.intro_zh: 緊張的新學員，遇見她的第一張瑜伽墊。
script.welcome_en: Welcome, glad you came! Today it's a first yoga class.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎你，很高興你來了！今天是一堂瑜伽初體驗。
script.outro: Namaste, friends! Practice breathing, and see you soon.
script.outro_zh: 瑜伽禮成，朋友們！記得常練習呼吸，我們不久後再見。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to repeat, say each line with me now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在到了跟讀的環節，每句跟著我說一次。
script.char_a_description: a slightly awkward woman in her early thirties with copper-red waves in a loose clip, wearing an oversized olive tee and black leggings, clutching a borrowed water bottle
script.char_b_description: a calm, lean man in his fifties with shoulder-length graying hair pulled back, wearing a linen henley and soft joggers, rolling a mat with practiced ease
script.youtube_title: 【🧘第一次上瑜伽課】「我忘記帶墊子」怎麼辦？18句教室對話🎧聽完就能開口💡｜🌱A2初級｜Yoga Class English
script.youtube_title_en: "I Even Forgot My Mat" — Walking Into a First Yoga Class
script.youtube_description:
第一次進瑜伽教室，緊張到忘記帶墊子？「簡易版動作」又是什麼意思？跟著 Lena 從報到、付款、說清楚自己的舊傷，到找到最後一排的位子，全程都有教練溫柔指引！整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢走進教室。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
First yoga class nerves: no mat, mystery words, and a sore back? Follow Lena through her very first session — borrowing a mat, paying the drop-in fee, speaking up about her injury, and learning that softer versions are always okay — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🧘第一次瑜伽課英文｜借用墊子・單次付費・簡易版動作｜聽完就敢上課｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次走進瑜伽教室，既期待又害怕？
沒帶墊子、聽不懂術語，到底該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進週六清晨的瑜伽教室，跟著 Lena 從借一張墊子、決定單次付費、坦白說出最近拉傷的背，到安心接受「簡易版動作」，全程都有教練溫柔指引，使用的是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧎 初到教室：例如「No worries, we lend mats free of charge.」。
💳 單次與會員：例如「Drop-in's twelve, or add it to your membership.」。
🌬️ 身體與安撫：例如「Thanks for telling me — I'll offer modifications.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次推開教室的門，你就能安心鋪好墊子，深呼吸開始！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the beginner yoga class?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə bɪˈɡɪnər ˈjoʊɡə klæs/
dialogue.zh: 你好，這是初學者的瑜伽課嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! First time here? Welcome, come on in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfɜrst taɪm hɪr ˈwɛlkəm kʌm ɑn ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 就是這堂！第一次來嗎？歡迎，請進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, brand new — I even forgot my mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛ brænd nu aɪ ˈivən fərˈɡɛt maɪ mæt/
dialogue.zh: 對，完全是新手——我連墊子都忘記帶了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, we lend mats free of charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz wi lɛnd mæts fri əv tʃɑrdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我們的墊子免費借你用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank goodness! Can I pay right here, or there?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs kæn aɪ peɪ raɪt hɪr ɔr ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 謝天謝地！我是在這裡付錢還是那邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drop-in's twelve, or add it to your membership.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdrɑpɪnz twɛlv ɔr æd ɪt tu jɔr ˈmɛmbərʃɪp/
dialogue.zh: 單次十二美元，或加進會員一齊算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve sounds fair. Do I need stretchy clothes?
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv saʊndz fɛr du aɪ nid ˈstrɛtʃi kloʊðz/
dialogue.zh: 十二塊很合理。要穿有彈性的衣服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, sweatpants work just fine here.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ət ɔl ˈswɛtˌpænts wɜrk dʒʌst faɪn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 完全不用，運動褲在這裡就很夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay! Um, I pulled my back recently, so…
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ ʌm aɪ pʊld maɪ bæk rɪˈsɛntli soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好！呃，我最近拉傷了背，所以……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for telling me — I'll offer modifications.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔr ˈtɛlɪŋ mi aɪl ˈɔfər ˌmɑdɪfɪˈkeɪʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你告訴我——我會提供簡易版的動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does that mean, exactly? Like easier moves?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðæt min ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk ˈizər muvz/
dialogue.zh: 確切是什麼意思？是指比較簡單的動作嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, you take the softer version of each pose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ju teɪk ðə ˈsɔfər ˈvɜrʒən ɑv itʃ poʊz/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，每個姿勢你都可以選輕鬆一點的版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps. I'd hate to do a pose wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛps aɪd heɪt tə du ə poʊz rɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣我安心多了，真怕把姿勢做錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody's watching, honestly — all in their own flow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbɑdiz ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ˈɑnəstli ɔl ɪn ðɛr oʊn floʊ/
dialogue.zh: 老實說沒人看別人——大家都專心走自己的節奏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel way better, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks mi fil weɪ ˈbɛtər ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，我現在感覺好太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the back corner, and breathe when unsure.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə bæk ˈkɔrnər ænd brin wɛn ʌnˈʃʊr/
dialogue.zh: 去最後面那一角，不確定的時候就深呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back corner, got it. I'm kind of excited now.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ˈkɔrnər ɡɑt ɪt aɪm kaɪnd ɑv ɪkˈsaɪtəd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 最後面那角，收到。我現在居然有點興奮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Love that. Class begins — roll out your mat!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʌv ðæt klæs bɪˈɡɪnz roʊl aʊt jɔr mæt/
dialogue.zh: 真好。要開課了——鋪開你的瑜伽墊吧！
